scope: Windows x64 pre-release for outside testers, with the recorded evidence and disclosed support limits
application_source: this repository's source at commit b50fc39; later commits change documents only, and the v0.4.0 tag names the final release-records commit
changes_since_previous_acceptance: 0.4.0: gradients, Gaussian blur, sharpen and noise filters, direct adjustments, named workspaces, smudge, blur and wet brushes, brush graphs with groups, formulas, sharing and an editor that shows node values, Brush Studio as a tab with a test pad, canvas paper shown on the canvas, and material layers (watercolor, dry media, thick paint with a saved relief) whose colors mix as pigments. Projects with material layers use the styled container and a relief trailer that older versions refuse. Evidence: local Verify Full, both packaging gates and a packaged startup; hosted Windows and Linux CI on the records commit before the tag. See RELEASE_DECISION.md. Previous accepted 0.3.0 binaries: dudel.exe 6E92CBFC...CE234D4B, dudel_thumbnails.dll C21A954B...31CFA0CD.
